title: A股节后流动性加量托底，长债与港股弱势压制追高；半导体订单、停牌重组与盈利下修分化
summary: A股10月8日复市，央行1.2万亿元三个月期买断式逆回购较到期量净加量2000亿元，首套房贷贴息政策进入实施期。AKShare的A股宽度仍是9月30日旧基线，港股10月7日14:02盘中恒指、恒科分别跌0.50%和0.81%。隔夜美股三大指数小跌、罗素2000跌1.3%，10年美债约5.28%；美光涨4.1%而台积电跌2.1%。盛美上海、荣丰控股、新亚制程列条件关注，飞龙股份列回避；最新美股排行未覆盖10月7日现金时段，行业与概念均按0行降级。

entries.summary_en: Mainland shares reopen Oct 8 with a RMB200bn net liquidity add from a RMB1.2tn three-month PBOC operation, while the first-home mortgage subsidy enters force. AKShare's A-share breadth remains a Sep 30 baseline; its Oct 7 14:02 Hong Kong snapshot had HSI down 0.50% and HSTECH down 0.81%. Overnight US indexes slipped, Russell 2000 fell 1.3% and the US 10-year closed near 5.28%; Micron gained 4.1% while TSMC lost 2.1%. ACM Shanghai, Rongfeng and Sunyes are conditional watches; Feilong is an avoid. US rankings miss the Oct 7 cash session and are degraded to zero rows.

关键词云图

1.2万亿流动性A股复市长债5.28%芯片分化盛美订单停牌重组飞龙降利油价回落
利好利空中性
重大新闻汇总
政策
央行今日加量投放三个月流动性
央行公告10月8日开展1.2万亿元、89天期买断式逆回购；10月同期限到期量为1万亿元，对应净加量2000亿元。流动性托底银行与高股息，但不能抵消公司层面的盈利风险。
政策
首套房贷贴息政策进入实施期
财政部、人民银行和金融监管总局的财金〔2026〕95号自10月1日起实施：合资格新发放首套房商业贷款获年化1个百分点、最长5年贴息，单户贴息贷款上限100万元；地产链需看成交兑现。
市场
A股今日复市，AKShare只提供假期前基线
交易所确认10月8日恢复交易。10月7日14:02生成的AKShare文件中，A股实际市场日仍为9月30日：2566涨、2824跌、175平，中位数-0.09%；科创50跌2.51%，不得冒充今日开盘。
港股
10月7日港股盘中宽度偏弱
AKShare于14:02记录恒指-0.50%、国指-0.59%、恒科-0.81%，679涨、958跌、1174平；收盘媒体口径为恒指-0.62%、恒科-0.68%，显示南向回归前风险偏好仍弱。
海外
美股冲高后回落，长债压制小盘
10月7日道指跌0.66%、标普500跌0.22%、纳指跌0.22%，罗素2000跌1.3%；10年期美债收益率收约5.28%。美光涨4.1%，台积电跌2.1%，芯片链不是单边信号。
产业
华为Mate 90以国产芯片与HarmonyOS 7强化自主链
华为发布Mate 90系列，采用Kirin 9050 Pro与HarmonyOS 7，高端机型性能较前代提升31%；同时公司承认先进芯片产能紧张且内存成本上升，利好与供给约束并存。
产业
盛美上海在手订单同比增长88.2%
截至9月29日在手订单170.73亿元；公司明确订单含已发货未确认收入与未来交付，且未必全部转化为收入。9月30日收294.28元、跌3.02%，公告后尚无成交确认。
公司
三安光电总经理解除留置
公司称10月5日收到解除留置通知，副董事长兼总经理林科闯已可正常履职，生产经营正常；这是治理不确定性边际缓解，仍需今日价格与后续披露确认。
公司
飞龙股份前三季度盈利明显下滑
公司预计归母净利润0.95亿至1.17亿元，同比下降59.2%至66.87%，原因包括行业竞争、原材料、汇率与新业务培育。9月30日收45.38元、跌2.45%，列回避。
公司
新亚制程筹划收购启元气体控股权
公司拟以发行股份及现金购买启元气体控股权并募资，预计构成重大资产重组，10月8日起停牌、预计不超过10个交易日披露方案。9月30日涨停收9.10元，条款与摊薄未知。
公司
荣丰控股筹划控制权变更
控股股东正筹划可能导致控股股东及实控人变更的事项，10月8日起停牌、预计不超过2个交易日。9月30日涨9.94%至18.69元，复牌前不能把事件当作已兑现收益。
HKEX
Z Fin 10月7日起短暂停牌
HKEX交易所通告显示Z Fin（01168）自10月7日上午9时起短暂停牌。停牌原因与复牌条件未形成可核验增量前，不进入多头候选。

美股夜盘行情总结

现货
三大指数小幅回落，小盘更弱
道指、标普500与纳指分别-0.66%、-0.22%和-0.22%，罗素2000跌1.3%；高利率对小盘和高估值资产的压力更明显。
跨资产
长债先冲高，油价冲高回落
美国10年期收益率盘中触及约5.36%后收约5.28%；WTI收88.33美元、Brent收99.78美元，IEA释放储备信号缓和油价，但能源成本仍高。
映射
存储偏强、设备与大盘科技分化
美光涨4.1%、闪迪涨1.9%，但台积电跌2.1%，半导体设备与软件ETF走弱。盛美订单催化可观察，但开盘若弱于设备板块即构成反证。

盘前结论

流动性净投放和房贷贴息降低节后系统性压力，但A股要一次性消化七日海外波动；长债5.28%与港股弱势限制追高。半导体优先看有订单支撑的盛美上海，但必须等待复市价格确认；重组停牌股仅作条件观察，飞龙股份因盈利下修回避。

重点个股关注

盛美上海
A.688082
条件关注
事件：在手订单170.73亿元、同比增88.2%，对应半导体设备需求，但公司明确订单不等于最终收入。
最近行情：9月30日收294.28元、跌3.02%；公告在盘后且假期无成交，当前价待10月8日开盘确认。
确认/失效：若复市后放量并强于半导体设备板块可继续观察；若高开低走、弱于板块或交付延迟则失效。
荣丰控股
A.000668
条件关注
事件：控股股东筹划控制权变更，可能改变控股股东与实控人。
最近行情：9月30日收18.69元、涨9.94%；10月8日起停牌，当前无法交易且条款尚未披露。
确认/失效：只在复牌、披露对价与治理安排后评估；若无实质注资、摊薄过大或复牌负反馈则失效。
新亚制程
A.002388
条件关注
事件：拟以发行股份及现金收购启元气体控股权并募资，预计构成重大资产重组。
最近行情：9月30日涨停收9.10元；10月8日起停牌，交易方案、估值和摊薄尚未知。
确认/失效：仅待方案完整披露、复牌价格与交易所审核反馈后判断；高估值、重摊薄或复牌大跌即失效。
飞龙股份
A.002536
回避
事件：前三季度归母净利润预计同比下降59.2%至66.87%，价格竞争与成本压力均为实质负面。
最近行情：9月30日收45.38元、跌2.45%，公告后尚无新成交。
回避依据：盈利下修叠加节前负反馈；除非后续订单转化与利润率出现可核验反转，否则不因液冷概念包装为多头。

板块轮动看板

流动性与高股息1.2万亿元中期投放带来净加量，但银行地产仍看成交和资产质量。
半导体设备/国产链盛美订单与华为新机提供催化；科创50节前-2.51%、台积电隔夜-2.1%要求价格确认。
并购重组荣丰、新亚均停牌，只有条款、审核和复牌反馈能把事件转化为可交易判断。
高估值成长/液冷概念长债高位与飞龙盈利下修构成双重反证，概念强度不能替代利润。

逻辑链

央行净加量与房贷贴息 → 节后流动性和刚需预期缓和 → 银行地产只在成交和资产质量确认后上调。
华为新机与盛美订单 → 国产芯片和设备链有公司级催化 → 科创50节前-2.51%且隔夜科技分化，必须用开盘相对强度验证。
美债约5.28% + 港股10月7日宽度偏弱 → 高估值追涨胜率下降 → 优先条件观察而非无差别多头。
停牌重组条款真空 + 飞龙盈利下修 → 事件标题不能替代收益与风险 → 前两者等待复牌条款，飞龙明确回避。

风险雷达

长假重定价A股七日无成交，开盘可能出现跳空、拥挤和快速反转。
长债与油价10年美债约5.28%，Brent仍接近100美元，高估值与成本敏感行业承压。
重组条款真空荣丰与新亚停牌且核心条款未披露，任何收益判断都属未确认。
数据时效A股AKShare为9月30日，港股为10月7日14:02盘中；美股排行未覆盖10月7日现金时段，均已明确降级。

数据来源与时间点

窗口：2026-10-07 08:43后至2026-10-08 08:34 CST。国内发现源实际尝试金十、财联社/科创板日报、证券时报与东方财富，并回到财政部、央行公告口径；HKEX披露易及交易所通告核验01168停牌。公司证据来自上市公司公告转载、ACM Research官方IR与交易所行情交叉。海外采用Reuters、AP、MarketWatch、金十截至10月7日美股收盘。AKShare schemaVersion=2、v1.18.94，接口A股指数stock_zh_index_spot_sina、个股stock_zh_a_spot，港股指数stock_hk_index_spot_sina；fetchedAt=2026-10-07 14:02 CST。A股marketDate=2026-09-30、calendarVerified=true、marketPhase=previous_close_baseline，2566涨/2824跌/175平、中位数-0.09%；港股marketPhase=intraday_snapshot，679涨/958跌/1174平、中位数0%，为10月7日14:02盘中。美股排行fetchedAt=2026-10-07 09:47:59 CST，仅覆盖10月6日现金时段，当前行业与概念均0行。生成时间：2026-10-08 08:34 CST。

Keyword Cloud

RMB1.2tn liquidityA-share reopeningUS 10Y at 5.28%Chip divergenceACM backlogDeal suspensionsFeilong profit dropOil eases
PositiveNegativeNeutral
Major News Roundup
Policy
PBOC adds three-month liquidity today
The PBOC will conduct RMB1.2tn of 89-day outright reverse repos on Oct 8. With RMB1tn maturing, the operation is a RMB200bn net add. It supports liquidity-sensitive sectors but does not override company earnings risk.
Policy
First-home mortgage subsidy enters force
MOF/PBOC/NFRA Circular Cai Jin [2026] 95 took effect Oct 1: eligible new first-home commercial mortgages receive a 1ppt annual subsidy for up to five years, capped at RMB1m of loan principal per household. Property-chain demand still needs transaction confirmation.
Market
A-shares reopen; AKShare is only a pre-holiday baseline
Exchanges confirm trading resumes Oct 8. The AKShare file generated Oct 7 14:02 still carries Sep 30 as the A-share market date: 2,566 advancers, 2,824 decliners, 175 flat and a -0.09% median; STAR 50 fell 2.51%. These are not today's opening data.
Hong Kong
Oct 7 intraday breadth was weak
At 14:02 AKShare showed HSI -0.50%, HSCEI -0.59% and HSTECH -0.81%, with 679 advancers, 958 decliners and 1,174 flat. Closing reports put HSI at -0.62% and HSTECH at -0.68%, signaling soft risk appetite before southbound flows return.
Overnight
Wall Street slipped as long yields hit small caps
On Oct 7 the Dow fell 0.66%, S&P 500 0.22%, Nasdaq 0.22% and Russell 2000 1.3%; the US 10-year closed near 5.28%. Micron rose 4.1% while TSMC fell 2.1%, so the chip signal is not one-way.
Industry
Huawei Mate 90 deepens the domestic stack
Huawei launched the Mate 90 with Kirin 9050 Pro and HarmonyOS 7, citing a 31% performance gain for top models. It also acknowledged constrained advanced-chip capacity and higher memory costs, leaving both upside and supply-side risk.
Industry
ACM Shanghai backlog rises 88.2%
Backlog was RMB17.073bn as of Sep 29. The company says it includes shipped but unrecognized tools and future deliveries, and may not fully convert to revenue. Shares closed Sep 30 at RMB294.28, down 3.02%; there is no post-announcement trade yet.
Company
Sanan manager released from detention
The company said it received notice on Oct 5 that vice chairman and general manager Lin Kechuang had been released and can resume duties, with operations normal. This reduces governance uncertainty only at the margin and needs price confirmation.
Company
Feilong guides to a sharp profit decline
Nine-month attributable profit is guided at RMB95m-RMB117m, down 59.2%-66.87%, citing pricing competition, raw materials, FX and early-stage businesses. It closed Sep 30 at RMB45.38, down 2.45%, and is an avoid.
Company
Sunyes plans to buy control of Qiyuan Gas
Sunyes plans a share-and-cash acquisition of Qiyuan Gas control plus financing, likely a major asset restructuring. Trading is suspended from Oct 8 for up to 10 trading days. It closed limit-up at RMB9.10 on Sep 30; terms and dilution remain unknown.
Company
Rongfeng owner considers a control transfer
The controlling shareholder is planning a deal that may change control and the actual controller. Shares are suspended from Oct 8 for up to two trading days. The stock closed Sep 30 at RMB18.69, up 9.94%; no return is realized before terms and resumption.
HKEX
Z Fin suspended from Oct 7
An HKEX exchange notice says Z Fin (01168) was suspended from 9:00 a.m. on Oct 7. Until the reason and resumption conditions are verifiable, it is excluded from bullish candidates.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Cash
Major indexes eased; small caps lagged
The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq lost 0.66%, 0.22% and 0.22%, while Russell 2000 fell 1.3%, showing the sharper high-rate pressure on smaller and long-duration assets.
Cross-assets
Yields spiked before easing; oil reversed
The US 10-year touched roughly 5.36% before closing near 5.28%. WTI settled at $88.33 and Brent at $99.78 as IEA reserve-release signals cooled the spike, though energy costs remain elevated.
Mapping
Memory outperformed while equipment and broad tech diverged
Micron rose 4.1% and Sandisk 1.9%, but TSMC fell 2.1% and equipment/software ETFs weakened. ACM's backlog catalyst is observable, but opening underperformance versus equipment peers would be a counter-signal.

Premarket Conclusion

Liquidity injection and mortgage subsidies cushion systemic risk, but A-shares must absorb seven days of offshore repricing. A 5.28% US 10-year yield and weak Hong Kong breadth argue against chasing. In semiconductors, ACM has an order-backed catalyst but needs reopening price confirmation. Suspended deal names are conditional watches only, while Feilong is an avoid on profit deterioration.

Focus Stocks

ACM Shanghai
A.688082
Conditional watch
Event: backlog reached RMB17.073bn, up 88.2%, directly tied to semiconductor equipment demand, but the company says backlog is not guaranteed revenue.
Latest trade: Sep 30 close RMB294.28, -3.02%. The announcement came after the close and the holiday left no post-event trade; the current price awaits Oct 8 confirmation.
Confirm/invalidate: maintain interest only if reopening volume and relative strength beat equipment peers; a fade, sector lag or delivery delay invalidates.
Rongfeng Holdings
A.000668
Conditional watch
Event: the controlling shareholder is considering a transfer that may change the controller and actual controller.
Latest trade: Sep 30 close RMB18.69, +9.94%. Trading is suspended from Oct 8; the stock is not tradable and terms are undisclosed.
Confirm/invalidate: reassess only after resumption and disclosure of consideration and governance; no real asset injection, heavy dilution or negative resumption feedback invalidates.
Sunyes
A.002388
Conditional watch
Event: proposed share-and-cash acquisition of Qiyuan Gas control plus financing, likely a major restructuring.
Latest trade: Sep 30 limit-up close RMB9.10. Trading is suspended from Oct 8; valuation and dilution are unknown.
Confirm/invalidate: wait for full terms, exchange review and resumption pricing. An excessive valuation, heavy dilution or a sharp resumption drop invalidates.
Feilong Auto
A.002536
Avoid
Event: nine-month attributable profit is guided down 59.2%-66.87%; pricing competition and costs are material negatives.
Latest trade: Sep 30 close RMB45.38, -2.45%, with no post-announcement trade yet.
Avoid rationale: earnings deterioration compounds the negative pre-holiday price signal. Do not repackage the cooling theme as bullish without verified order conversion and margin recovery.

Sector Rotation Board

Liquidity & high dividendRMB1.2tn of medium-term funding is a net add, but banks and property still depend on sales and asset quality.
Semiconductor equipment/domestic stackACM backlog and Huawei's handset launch provide catalysts; STAR 50 at -2.51% pre-holiday and TSMC at -2.1% overnight demand price confirmation.
M&A restructuringsRongfeng and Sunyes are suspended; only terms, review and resumption feedback can turn events into tradable conclusions.
High-duration growth/cooling themeHigh long yields plus Feilong's profit warning are dual counter-signals; thematic strength cannot replace earnings.

Logic Chain

PBOC net liquidity and mortgage subsidy → easier reopening liquidity and demand expectations → upgrade banks/property only after sales and asset-quality confirmation.
Huawei launch plus ACM backlog → company-level catalyst for the domestic chip/equipment chain → STAR 50's pre-holiday -2.51% and mixed overnight tech require opening relative-strength confirmation.
US 10-year near 5.28% plus weak Oct 7 Hong Kong breadth → lower odds for chasing long-duration growth → favor conditional watches over blanket bullish calls.
Undisclosed suspended-deal terms plus Feilong's profit warning → event labels do not replace returns and risks → wait for terms on the first two; keep Feilong as an avoid.

Risk Radar

Holiday repricingA-shares had no trade for seven days, raising gap, crowding and reversal risk.
Yields and oilThe US 10-year is near 5.28% and Brent near $100, pressuring long-duration and cost-sensitive sectors.
Deal-term vacuumRongfeng and Sunyes are suspended with core terms undisclosed; returns are unconfirmed.
Data freshnessA-share AKShare data are from Sep 30, Hong Kong from Oct 7 14:02 intraday, and US rankings miss the Oct 7 cash session; all are explicitly degraded.
